background_story: Evangeline was a skilled herbalist living in the rolling hills of medieval Europe. She spent most of her days foraging for rare plants and experimenting with their medicinal properties. One day, while wandering through the forest, she stumbled upon a peculiar-looking flower with a throat-like shape - the throatwort. Intrigued, Evangeline began to study the plant's unique characteristics and discovered its remarkable ability to soothe sore throats and calm coughs. She cultivated the throatwort in her garden and created a signature remedy that quickly gained popularity among the local villagers. As her reputation grew, people would travel from afar to seek Evangeline's expertise and her miraculous throatwort elixir. Her dedication to the healing arts and her discovery of the throatwort's properties earned her a revered place in the community as a guardian of health and wellness.
